Rudranath Trek

A Panch Kedar pilgrimage through alpine meadows and rhododendron forests to the temple where Lord Shiva's face is worshipped.

6D / 5N itinerary
Delhi to Sagar Village to Delhi
Panch Kedar pilgrimage
Lwiti Bugyal alpine meadows
View Itinerary Book This Trek
AT A GLANCE

About the Trip

Rudranath is one of the Panch Kedar — the five sacred Shiva temples of the Garhwal Himalayas — where Lord Shiva's face (mukh) is worshipped. Reaching it means trekking from Sagar village through dense forest, past the alpine meadows of Lwiti Bugyal, and on through rhododendron forests and high-altitude landscapes to the temple itself.

Along the way you'll camp under a star-lit Himalayan sky, and from Rudranath catch views of Trishul, Nanda Devi and Nanda Ghunti. The journey closes with a visit to Kalpeshwar — the only Panch Kedar temple accessible all year round — before the drive back to Delhi.

BASE VILLAGE
Sagar, Chamoli
REGION
Garhwal Himalayas
TREK GRADE
Moderate, high-altitude
MEALS
4 breakfasts & 4 dinners
WHAT AWAITS YOU

Highlights of the Trip

Rudranath Temple — one of the Panch Kedar, where Lord Shiva's face is worshipped.

Lwiti Bugyal — a night camping in serene alpine meadows en route.

Himalayan peak views — Trishul, Nanda Devi and Nanda Ghunti from near the temple.

Kalpeshwar Temple — the only Panch Kedar accessible all year, where Shiva's jata is worshipped.

Devprayag Sangam — the sacred confluence that forms the Ganga, visited en route.

Star-lit camping — nights under the open Himalayan sky at Lwiti Bugyal and near Rudranath.

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

  • Reporting Point: Akshardham Metro Station, Delhi.
  • Reporting Time: 9:30 PM. Departure: 10:00 PM.
  • Meet & Greet: Meet your Trip Captain & get introduced to fellow travelers.
  • Journey Begins: Board the vehicle & begin the overnight road journey to Sagar Village (the base point of Rudranath trek).
  • Dinner Break: At a local eatery en route.
  • Early Morning: Drive through scenic Himalayan roads.
  • Devprayag Sangam: En route stop at the confluence of Alaknanda & Bhagirathi, forming the holy Ganga.
  • Arrival: Reach Sagar Village (base point for the Rudranath trek).
  • Settle In: Check into your accommodation & relax after the long journey.
  • Overnight Stay: In Sagar Village.
  • Breakfast: Early breakfast, then gear up for your trek.
  • Trek Begins: Scenic hike from Sagar Village towards Lwiti Bugyal.
  • En Route: Walk through dense forests, mountain streams, and meadows with breathtaking Himalayan views.
  • Arrival: Reach Lwiti Bugyal campsite by late afternoon.
  • Overnight Stay: In tents at Lwiti Bugyal (sharing basis).
  • Trek: Through alpine meadows, Rhododendron forests, and high-altitude landscapes.
  • Arrival: Reach the sacred Rudranath Temple — one of the Panch Kedar, where Lord Shiva's face is worshipped.
  • Darshan: Seek blessings at the temple and spend time exploring the serene surroundings.
  • Views: Mesmerizing views of peaks like Trishul, Nanda Devi & Nanda Ghunti.
  • Overnight Stay: In tents near Rudranath, under a star-lit Himalayan sky.
  • Sunrise: Wake up early to witness the magical sunrise at Rudranath Temple.
  • Morning Prayers: Attend morning prayers / spend some quiet spiritual time.
  • Descent: After breakfast, begin your descent back towards Sagar Village.
  • Arrival: Reach Sagar by evening and settle into your accommodation.
  • Overnight Stay: At Sagar Village.
  • Departure: After breakfast, depart from Sagar Village.
  • Kalpeshwar Temple: Drive towards Kalpeshwar — the only Panch Kedar accessible throughout the year, where Lord Shiva's hair (jata) is worshipped.
  • Darshan: Seek blessings at Kalpeshwar Temple and also visit the nearby Dhyan Badri Temple.
  • Return Journey: Begin the return journey towards Delhi with group vibes, stories & memories.
  • Travel: Overnight road journey.
WHAT YOU PAY FOR

Inclusions & Exclusions

Included in your package

  • Travel by AC & comfortable bus / traveller
  • 4 night stays: 2N Sagar, 1N Lwiti Bugyal, 1N near Rudranath Temple
  • Meals: 4 breakfasts and 4 dinners
  • Sightseeing as per the itinerary
  • Trek guide and briefing about the trek
  • Experienced trip captain throughout the trip

Not included in your package

  • Any extra meal and stay arrangements apart from those mentioned under inclusions
  • Any entry fees, extra expenses for optional activities, or tickets unless quoted in inclusions
  • Cost of snow chains or 4x4 vehicles if required due to heavy snowfall
  • Travel insurance and other benefits
  • Cost escalation due to unforeseen reasons like weather, road conditions, landslides, natural calamities, roadblocks, or other forced circumstances beyond our control
